name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 10 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-06-11, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 5.01 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
